principle.name: THE CATCH SPENDS VERTICAL DEBT WHILE FORWARD DEBT SURVIVES
principle.summary: A convincing forward catch is prepared before launch, distinguishes probe contact from trusted support, lets the root continue past first touch, compresses deeply after ownership is earned, then spends the remaining forward debt through an explicit support roll from foot to forefoot to toe while upper-body and free-leg lag remain unresolved.
principle.minimal_maximal_unit: one repaired forward support-ownership handoff from asymmetric rear coil through launch/probe/catch to explicit support roll and unresolved recovery-debt exit
